The diffraction model is the 293(2) K ambient single-crystal refinement in the official Boffa Ballaran et al. (2025) supplement. That article states that this crystal came from the same synthesis run as the different crystal used for the 2007 EOS measurement. The deposited Pbnm symmetry operators give multiplicities 4, 4, 4, and 8 for Ir, Ca, O1, and O2, respectively, reproducing Ca4Ir4O12 and Z=4. Its 229.526 A^3 lattice volume is distinct from the 2007 fitted EOS V0=229.463 A^3 and is not substituted for it.

This record is limited to the Pbnm CaIrO3 perovskite polymorph and must not be used for the Cmcm post-perovskite. V0 is the four-formula-unit conventional-cell volume. The source describes V0, K0, and K' together as refined parameters and marks none fixed, so fixed\_parameters is empty. The printed standard deviations are retained without conversion to a confidence interval, and numerical covariance is absent rather than assumed zero.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.
